column8: notes
Mac NavigationSplitView wires Home, Agents, Schedules, Skills, Extensions, Workspaces, and Settings to live list/detail surfaces.
Shared SessionRowPresentation + grouping (Your Turn / Working / stopped-by-day). Mac paints SwiftUI rows; iOS/iPad use SessionRow.
Shared SessionGridRenderer π-grid on both. Mac no longer uses emoji/SF Symbol for default identity.
Mac can paint a shared completion date but has no unread producer. A Mac unread store is an explicit non-goal.
Shared SessionSearchStore + SessionListSearchPresentation. Mac Home uses server FTS plus local fuzzy match; workspace catalog search stays a name filter.
Rows show worktree identity. The workspace picker scopes session fetch/create/import, files, Git, media, and viewer routes to the selected worktree.
Mac-only caption strip for live sessions. iOS folds this into inbox sections.
Mac keeps host first-run server/TCC onboarding. iOS product What's New and feature-education surfaces are not a Mac finish-line goal.

The Mac scene accepts oppi://session/<id>; known sessions open directly while uncached sessions are fetched over the owner socket. Cold-start links retry after server readiness; attention-banner taps use the same route.
Mac MenuBarExtra + popover (open/quit, server status). StatsTabView is live in Settings; SessionsTabView is not in the menu-bar scene.
The production document surface is the wide side column beside the timeline with system fullscreen escalation. A detached WindowGroup-first viewer is an explicit non-goal.
iOS/iPad onboard by pairing to a server. Mac is the host.
Mac PairView + nearby advertiser under App Settings.
Mac owns Node/CLI process, auto-start, health. iOS never runs the server.

column2: Owner Unix-socket auth (sk_ only on socket)
column8: Architecture rule. iOS uses paired HTTPS/WSS + token.
Notifications/mic/screen etc. for local server + tools.
Mac Settings panes. iOS has no host doctor.
Mac remains the local Oppi host and owner-socket client. The URL stash does not authenticate or switch active servers; Mac-as-remote-client is an explicit non-goal.
Mac General settings.
Shared ChatSessionManager. Mac Unix socket; iOS paired connection.
Wired on Mac Home + workspace detail.
Workspace stopped sections show importable Pi TUI rows and import into the selected worktree before opening the ordinary session view.
Mac inbox row shows eye.slash when presented.
Mac displays server-derived titles and identifies Server as the active title source. On-device and Off controls are explicit non-goals.
Mac uses normal workspace creation and guided control-session entry points. The iOS Quick Session sheet, Shortcut, and share intake are explicit non-goals.
Agents, Schedules, and Workspaces launch ordinary control-session chats. Retries reuse one frozen atomic request/key; revised drafts remain local for a new send.
Mac composer bar implements send, abort-turn, steer vs queue follow-up.
Mac records microphone audio and streams server dictation over the owner Unix socket. An on-device dictation engine and picker are explicit non-goals.
Mac supports attachment selection and drop plus file/image paste, image thumbnails, dedupe/removal, mixed-text preservation, and owned temp cleanup.
MacFileMentionAutocomplete on composer; iOS FileSuggestionList.
The live Mac composer loads shared slash-command metadata, filters suggestions, and inserts a selected command without taking composer key ownership.
MacModelPickerSheet + persist.
Mac thinking menu on action row.
Mac ask cards support single choice, multi-select, custom input, submit, and ignore over the active session route.
Mac paints generic status, widget, progress, terminal, markdown, text-span, and activity-row metadata above/below the composer without extension-name branches.
Mac composer Cmd-Return sends. Sol: keep this; viewer open must not steal it while composer focused.
OppiCore CommonMark parsing feeds the Mac SwiftUI/AppKit painter, including GFM tables and HTML/SVG preview. UIKit ChatView/timeline painters remain iOS-only by design.

column2: Mermaid / LaTeX / images / video in markdown
column8: Mac has native Mermaid, LaTeX, image/SVG, and authenticated video painters; nested relative media resolves from the Markdown file path.
Mac paints thinking rows with measured 200-point collapse/expand behavior and preserves the shared timeline model.
Compact turns are an iPhone-specific presentation preference. Mac keeps its native timeline and activity chrome.
Live session chrome shows context/token/cost stats and loaded-resource states, with loading, failed, unknown, empty, and populated states kept distinct.
Mac ships server-backed timeline search/filter/jump. iOS Tree mode, branch navigation, and fork actions are explicit non-goals.
Selectable Markdown, code, terminal, diff, and document text can stage, edit, remove, and send review comments from the composer.
Workspace, host, and session wiki/Markdown links open the side-column viewer; relative and nested media preserve source directory and worktree scope.
Both show tool title/status/path-ish detail. Mac ToolTimelineBubble.
Session-owned row state expands shared tool descriptors for code, diff, terminal, file, and media output; large output stays outside hot row state.
Mac opens the selected tool/file document in the wide side column and can escalate the same main window to system fullscreen. It does not copy the UIKit viewer.
OppiCore shares Tree-sitter/token ranges and fallback scanning; Mac applies AppKit colors and the selected bundled code font.
Mac paints structured diff plans inline and in the document column with changed-file routing and review-comment selection.
Shared ANSI parsing feeds Mac inline and document-column terminal painters with preference-aware monospaced typography.
Shared media descriptors drive Mac inline/document image rendering and authenticated file loads.
Mac plays authenticated workspace/session audio and video through the owner Unix-socket range adapter and native AVPlayer view.
The side column uses PDFKit for PDFs and a CSP-constrained source/preview flow for HTML and SVG.
One OppiCore catalog defines Mac-default and Vim actions by focus. Mac Settings exposes a live persisted mode picker; composer letters and Cmd-Return remain composer-owned.

column2: Share catalog to iOS/iPad hardware keyboard
column8: The iOS/iPad hardware-keyboard responder installs and executes the same OppiCore catalog through a thin UIKit adapter.

column2: Mac menu commands for standard shortcuts
column8: Focused timeline/viewer handlers provide the standard and Vim actions. Duplicating those routes in Mac command menus is an explicit non-goal; no global key monitor is used.
The selected-worktree file browser lists directories and opens supported files in the shared side-column document surface.
The session inspector opens changed-file previews and diffs, including image/text content and review-comment selection.
The Mac workspace surface loads selected-worktree Git status and opens per-file diffs in the document column.
Mac workspace detail + create sheet.
Mac has native create/edit/delete for common host fields plus Ask Oppi/Edit with Oppi. The full iOS sandbox/resource configuration form is an explicit non-goal.
Mac has live list/detail/create/edit/archive and guided Edit with Oppi. The full advanced native field set for model, tools, resources, and launch constraints is an explicit non-goal.
Mac has live list/detail/create/edit/status controls and guided Edit with Oppi. The full advanced native trigger/action field set is an explicit non-goal.
Mac has live list/detail, enable state, and SKILL.md content. An auxiliary Skill file-tree editor is an explicit non-goal.
Mac has live searchable list/detail surfaces, contributed-tool metadata, load errors, and enable/disable controls.
Shared ThemeStore. Mac uses macOS Appearance; iOS uses Display & Brightness.
Mac Settings imports Oppi theme JSON from files or discovered host themes and supports removal.
Mac Settings exposes live built-in/emoji avatar and spinner choices with previews; session timeline chrome consumes the persisted values. Mac intentionally does not offer or decode Genmoji.
Mac Settings controls bundled code families, code/message scale, and message mono mode. Live timeline, viewer, inspector, diff, terminal, and extension painters consume them.
Mac applies server voice-reply details and can autoplay live WAV or tap-play completed media. A configurable reply-mode selector and on-device dictation picker are explicit non-goals.
Haptics remain an iPhone interaction surface and are an explicit Mac non-goal.
Mac relies on host account security and TCC. The iOS/iPad app-level biometric lock is an explicit non-goal.
Mac prevents idle display sleep for running sessions. Authoritative recent-session snapshots add and remove reasons with latest-request-wins reconciliation.
Mac Settings reports and clears the pasted-attachment temp cache that Mac owns. Mac does not invent the iOS TimelineCache.
ActivityKit and its experiment control remain iOS/iPadOS-only and are an explicit Mac non-goal.
The live Settings Stats destination shows health, cost, model, workspace, and daily detail from the local server monitor.

column2: Session cost / context tokens in chrome
column8: Selected live sessions expose context usage, token/cost totals, and loaded resources in toolbar chrome.
The OppiShareExtension intake flow remains iOS/iPadOS-only and is an explicit Mac non-goal.
The OppiControlWidget target remains iOS/iPadOS-only and is an explicit Mac non-goal.
The OppiActivityExtension target remains iOS/iPadOS-only and is an explicit Mac non-goal.
Mac posts local ask banners when attention is outside the visible session, deduplicates/cancels them, and routes taps through the session deeplink path.
Mac and iOS/iPad hardware responders execute the shared focus-aware catalog; the live Mac Settings picker switches Mac-default and Vim modes.
